## Play: Lift Lab

::: {.callout-tip title="Play: Lift Lab (10 to 15 min)" icon="false"}
Is this lift safe? Redesign a lifting job until its [Lifting Index]{.term} is 1 or less, for as little money as you can. The game uses the [NIOSH lifting equation]{.term} [@waters1994niosh] and shows how reach, height, twisting, pace, and grip each shrink the [recommended weight limit]{.term}.
